prior_art_boundary: The duad-syntheme doily, Schlaefli double-six labelling, exceptional S6 outer automorphism, and uniqueness of the self-orthogonal [15,5,6] binary code are classical/known. The repo contribution here is the explicit objectwise identification tying its previously separate cubic-surface classifier and Pass6533 code certificate together, plus the closed twisted-cut formula and exact replay of the earlier cycle-type table.
